sv.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
sv.translated: Öppna en tidsförloppsfilm, klicka på varje objekt i valfri bildruta för att markera dess startpunkt och låt SAM2 följa varje objekt genom filmen. Klicka igen i en bildruta där det blev fel och propagera en gång till.

de.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
de.translated: Öffnen Sie einen Zeitraffer-Film, klicken Sie jedes Objekt auf einem beliebigen Bild an, um es als Startpunkt zu setzen, und lassen Sie SAM2 jedes Objekt durch den Film verfolgen. Klicken Sie erneut auf einem Bild, auf dem es falsch lief, und propagieren Sie noch einmal.

es.translated: Elige una película de lapso de tiempo

es.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
es.translated: Abre una película de lapso de tiempo, haz clic en cada objeto en cualquier fotograma para marcarlo como semilla y deja que SAM2 siga cada objeto a lo largo de la película. Vuelve a hacer clic en un fotograma donde falló y propaga otra vez.

zh_CN.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
zh_CN.translated: 打开一部延时影片，在任意帧上点击每个对象以设置种子，让 SAM2 在整部影片中追踪每个对象。在出错的帧上再次点击，然后再传播一次。

fr.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
fr.translated: Ouvrez un film en accéléré, cliquez sur chaque objet dans n'importe quelle image pour l'amorcer, et laissez SAM2 suivre chaque objet tout au long du film. Cliquez à nouveau sur une image où le suivi a échoué et propagez une fois de plus.

pt.translated: Escolha um filme de lapso de tempo

pt.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
pt.translated: Abra um filme de lapso de tempo, clique em cada objeto em qualquer quadro para marcá-lo como semente e deixe o SAM2 seguir cada objeto ao longo do filme. Clique novamente em um quadro onde houve erro e propague mais uma vez.

hi.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
hi.translated: एक टाइमलैप्स मूवी खोलें, किसी भी फ़्रेम पर हर वस्तु को सीड करने के लिए उस पर क्लिक करें, और SAM2 को पूरी मूवी में हर वस्तु का अनुसरण करने दें। जहाँ गलती हुई हो उस फ़्रेम पर फिर से क्लिक करें और एक बार फिर प्रसारित करें।

ko.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
ko.translated: 타임랩스 동영상을 열고 아무 프레임에서나 각 객체를 클릭해 시드를 지정한 뒤 SAM2가 동영상 전체에서 모든 객체를 추적하게 하세요. 잘못된 프레임에서 다시 클릭하고 한 번 더 전파하세요.

is.source: Open a timelapse movie, click each object on any frame to seed it, and let SAM2 follow every object through the movie. Click again on a frame where it went wrong and propagate once more.
is.translated: Opnaðu tímaröðunarmynd, smelltu á hvern hlut í hvaða ramma sem er til að setja upphafspunkt hans og láttu SAM2 rekja hvern hlut í gegnum myndina. Smelltu aftur í ramma þar sem eitthvað fór úrskeiðis og dreifðu enn á ný.
